origin: New AI-generated dialogue illustrations referenced to the current original NPC sprites. These are not supplied sprite frames.
art_direction: Detailed pixel art, muted olive/umber/cream, warm side light, dark background. Same face/clothes/camera in each row. Columns neutral, friendly, irritated, worried. Separate identities from original sprite reference.
review: All 36 faces and clothing reviewed against the nine source sprites; cropped uniformly to existing dialogue frame. No animated sprite was generated.
